create_engine_inference: create an SGLang Engine instance to run LLM inference with configurable server arguments and parallelism settings
run_generate_request: run a generate request on the Engine with prompt text, sampling params, and optional multimodal inputs to get text completions
run_async_generate_request: run an async generate request on the Engine with prompt text and sampling params to get streaming or single text completions
run_encode_embeddings: run an encode request on the Engine with prompt text and optional multimodal inputs to get embedding vectors
update_model_weights: update model weights on the Engine from tensor, disk, or distributed source without restarting the inference server
